description: SUM(...) as a scalar subquery is nullable, because SUM (unlike COUNT) returns SQL NULL, not zero, over an empty set

columns.name: total_spent
columns.note: SUM over zero matching orders is NULL, not 0, so the scalar subquery is nullable

name: scalar_subquery_sum_nullable
query_sql:
-- @name GetUsersWithTotalSpent
-- @returns :many
SELECT id, name, (SELECT SUM(total) FROM orders WHERE user_id = users.id) AS total_spent FROM users
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE users (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, email TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', bio TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now())
CREATE TABLE orders (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), total INTEGER NOT NULL, notes TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now())
